source_row.english: Still other cases would be where the monk told stories to entertain others at a show put on by some performer, or too where he began reciting some wrong commentary written by a non-Buddhist.

spans.rationale: The complete agent compound names the performer. MKHAN is not an independent English person word here, and no member is invented inside performer.
The second ZLOS GAR is the independent performance noun, distinct from the same syllables inside the preceding performer compound.
The performance verb is rendered by the complete phrasal verb put on. Its subject is the performer, not the monk who tells stories. Exclude by some and the bound relative ending.
Standalone SU supplies the locative/occasion relation at the show. The related GNAS SKABS circumstance noun remains unbanked; neither SU nor GNAS SKABS is assigned the opening general cases frame.
These are the audience whom the stories entertain, not the performer or the monk inherited from360.
The please/gladden sense is realized as entertain in this storytelling context. Exclude its purpose marker to, which is separately supplied by PHYIR.
The purpose particle owns the exact to before entertain. It is not the on belonging to put on, or the by before either performer or non-Buddhist.
The complete narrative/accounts compound supplies stories, without fabricating separate GTAM or RGYUD exponents.
Speaking/telling verb owns told in the monk clause. It is distinct from BYED PA, the performer putting on the show.
The conjunction joins alternative examples and is rendered or. Too and where remain outside this narrow connector.
Whole established outsider-category noun is rendered non-Buddhist. No independent Buddhist or negative-prefix member is claimed.
The textual-work noun supplies commentary. Written by is English relational expansion of its attribution, not part of this noun.
The bad/wrong evaluative word qualifies this commentary; it does not refer to the later362 wrong desire.
The full recitation verb owns reciting. Began is left outside, and CHAGS NAS is not falsely mapped to that single onset verb.

omissions.reason: The circumstance/time noun participates in the at-a-show setting, while the opening cases is the broader continuing-example frame. Neither a secure independent noun nor a single complete local counterpart is established. SU alone records the overt at relation; this omission is not an absence null.

Tibetan attachment/desire toward the wrong commentary is recast in English as where he began reciting. CHAGS has desire/become senses, but began by itself does not securely own the entire object-directed motive or this sequence. Leave the relation, motive and linkage unbanked; no false CHAGS/began or NAS/where atom.

The final exemplifying formula is distributed into Still other cases would be and the closing punctuation. Its literal like/as and closure do not have a separately secure contiguous exponent here. Bound attribution grammar is also not assigned written by. No uncertainty is converted into a null.

omissions.english: Still other cases would be where the monk; a; by some; too where he began; some; written by a
